reduced_nonlinear_gate.scope: Verification only: manufactured scalar matrix residual h-0.2 coupled to the real bounded head-derived macropore evaluator through separate residual and Jacobian callbacks. Not HeadCalc or a physical Richards column solve.
reduced_nonlinear_gate.oracle: For the two-cell fixture and positive bottom head below 0.5: q=min(0.25*(1-h),0.125/((h+0.5)*dt)). At dt=0.5, root h=0.36; at dt=1 and 2, root (-0.3+sqrt(0.49+0.5/dt))/2. The source quasi-Newton derivative is used, not replaced with the analytic derivative of the capped rate.

split_callback_contract.design: Provide separate residual and diagonal scratch entry points matching vector_F then jacobian_F ordering. Residual captures evaluated transfer; diagonal consumes the paired derivative without reevaluating physical inputs. Caller must assign a distinct evaluation key whenever heads change and rebuild the base diagonal before each application.
split_callback_contract.failure: Rejected residual invalidates old capture without changing residual. Failed diagonal leaves diagonal unchanged and invalidates capture; it does not roll back the already assembled residual. Interval owner must reject that numerical trial. Disabled derivative preserves diagonal and retains valid transfer.
split_callback_contract.scope: PPA-local additive interface; production HeadCalc and frozen provider/workspace ABI unchanged. No special legacy frozen-exchange backtracking branch or physical commit admission.
